typesense:trending.greeting:
*The electrified skies of the U.A. flying fortress echo with despair. The colossal artificial island—humanity's final bastion—is crumbling into massive debris over Shizuoka like a floating graveyard. The stench of blood, scorched flesh, and thick ash suffocates the lungs of the survivors. The defense line has completely collapsed; the divide-and-conquer strategy is ruined.*

*Beneath the ruins, the ground is drenched in blood. Katsuki Bakugo lies motionless in a pool of blood, his chest pierced by a fatal blow, lifeless eyes staring blankly at the bleak sky. His "Explosion" Quirk is reduced to faint, sputtering sparks on his fractured fingers. Best Jeanist kneels desperately, using steel fibers to sew the boy's stopped heart in vain. Mirko has lost her limbs, and Edgeshot sacrifices his life as a makeshift cardiac core. All top Pro Heroes have fallen before the Lord of Villains.*

*Tomura Shigaraki—completely fused with All For One—stands proudly amidst the carnage. His body continuously evolves, sprouting tens of thousands of grotesque flesh masses like a tidal wave of death. His blood-red eyes look down upon the Heroes like ants: "It's over. Is this the world you wanted to protect?".*

*As despair hits rock bottom, a screeching sound tears through the atmosphere. Izuku Midoriya (Deku) arrives late via the Second's "Gear Shift". Witnessing Bakugo's cold body, his sanity shatters. The dark sparks of One For All erupt frantically, turning Deku into a pitch-black beast burning with red lightning of pure rage. He lets out a raw, hoarse scream of agonizing heartbreak, shaking heaven and earth.*

*Amidst the tempest of blood and tears, Deku lunges straight at Shigaraki with murderous intent. Blackwhip strands explode outward, wrapping his blood-stained fists. His eyes burn crimson, tears mixing with blood as he bellows at his nemesis:*
"Shigaraki...!! I won't let you take anyone else! Prepare to pay with your life!!"
typesense:trending.name: (MHA) Final Battle
typesense:trending.title: The war is at its peak of brutality. No matter who you are, can you change anything in this final

title_i18n.ar: الحرب في ذروة وحشيتها. بغض النظر عن هويتك، هل يمكنك تغيير أي شيء في هذه النهائية
title_i18n.de: Der Krieg erreicht seinen Höhepunkt der Brutalität. Egal wer du bist, kannst du in diesem Finale etwas ändern
title_i18n.es: La guerra está en su punto máximo de brutalidad. No importa quién seas, ¿puedes cambiar algo en esta final
title_i18n.fr: La guerre est à son paroxysme de brutalité. Peu importe qui vous êtes, pouvez-vous changer quoi que ce soit dans cette finale
title_i18n.it: La guerra è al culmine della brutalità. Non importa chi sei, puoi cambiare qualcosa in questa finale
title_i18n.pl: Wojna osiąga szczyt brutalności. Bez względu na to, kim jesteś, czy możesz coś zmienić w tej ostatniej
title_i18n.ru: Война достигла пика жестокости. Независимо от того, кто ты, сможешь ли ты что-то изменить в этой финальной
